title: Sonic Search
description: Index archived snapshot content into a Sonic search backend.

bash.install:
"$ABXPKG_PYTHON" - <<'PY'
import hashlib
import os
import platform
import shutil
import sys
import tarfile
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

if not sys.platform.startswith('linux') or platform.machine().lower() not in {'x86_64', 'amd64'}:
    raise SystemExit('The prebuilt Sonic provider supports Linux x86_64 only')
url = 'https://github.com/valeriansaliou/sonic/releases/download/v1.7.4/v1.7.4-x86_64-gnu.tar.gz'
expected = '81b1d017992ffc9957dc27f7f6c78fd2cf1a4e09c89295dc8b15d15ded01b8ae'
install_root = Path(os.environ['INSTALL_ROOT'])
bin_dir = Path(os.environ['BIN_DIR'])
install_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
bin_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
archive_path = install_root / '.sonic.tar.gz.tmp'
staging_path = bin_dir / '.sonic.tmp'
try:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    request = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'abxpkg sonic bootstrap/1.7.4'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=120) as response, archive_path.open('wb') as target:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: response.read(1024 * 1024), b''):
            digest.update(chunk)
            target.write(chunk)
    if digest.hexdigest() != expected:
        raise RuntimeError(f'Refusing {url}: expected SHA256 {expected}, got {digest.hexdigest()}')
    with tarfile.open(archive_path, mode='r:gz') as archive:
        member = next((item for item in archive.getmembers() if item.name in {'sonic/sonic', './sonic/sonic'}), None)
        if member is None:
            raise RuntimeError('Sonic archive did not contain sonic/sonic')
        source = archive.extractfile(member)
        if source is None:
            raise RuntimeError('Sonic archive member sonic/sonic was not a file')
        with source, staging_path.open('wb') as target:
            shutil.copyfileobj(source, target)
    staging_path.chmod(0o755)
    os.replace(staging_path, bin_dir / 'sonic')
finally:
    archive_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    staging_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
PY
